user_instruction: The top 3,000 is only meant to be a rough approximation to have 3,000 US equities to work with. It does not need to be precise.
interpretation: Replace exact largest-3000 global capitalization and cutoff proof with an explicitly enumerated, reproducible practical US-listed equity cohort, targeting 3000 distinct companies on the existing historical basis.

selection_method.preferred: Retained historically dated eligibility and issuer identity evidence, ordered by available market-cap proxy descending with deterministic canonical-company-ID tie-break.
selection_method.proxy_semantics: Label proxy and its effective/publication/source dates explicitly. Do not certify exact capitalization or exact global rank.
selection_method.membership_eligible: Supported US common-equity/eligible ADR/ADS listing and usable issuer identity; retain original common-equity eligibility categories.
selection_method.ambiguous_identity_or_listing: Record exclusion reason and advance deterministically to next eligible candidate before freeze.
selection_method.capitalization_only_uncertainty: Does not block cohort membership; use supported selection proxy, preserve unknown financial values separately.
forbidden_selection_inputs: Survival or listing status today substituted for historical eligibility
Observed downstream completeness or ease of data acquisition

withdrawn_membership_requirements: Proof that selected companies are precisely the largest 3000 by fully reconstructed total company common-equity capitalization
Exact global rank or rank-3000 cutoff proof
Resolving every unselected challenger or all 714 historical review cases merely to prove exact cutoff
Exact share-count/ADR/capitalization reconstruction solely as a membership prerequisite
retained_requirements: Frozen explicit selected-company IDs and versioned policy/manifest hashes
Identity and company deduplication; dated eligible instrument relationships across August-September
Independently checked membership under this new policy, with retained source references
All required data-family accuracy, provenance, applicability and temporal semantics for the selected cohort
Independent expected populations and honest missing/conflicting/unavailable data
No replacing frozen members to improve coverage; no treating approximate cap as an exact usable financial factor
Preserve old snapshots, evidence, task history, source originals, controls, owner/fence/stop, cumulative counters and deadline
immediate_action: Implement a versioned practical-cohort acceptance route and adapt obsolete exact-ranking-only prerequisites. Produce and verify a frozen cohort and dated instrument manifest; wire required downstream tasks to it.
active_work_handoff: Current executor reaches a safe checkpoint, reconciles effects and releases active claims. Retain useful identity/data evidence. Do not start further exact-cutoff-only work as a prerequisite; classify superseded requirements honestly.
original_scope_hash_semantics: Preserved original mission identity; this separate versioned amendment changes selection precision only.
